name: weather-wet-glass-simple
description: WEATHER-WET-GLASS + WEATHER-BACKDROP simple rung, with an IN-SESSION CONTROL ARM. Everything is measured inside ONE boot at ONE pinned pose (living/dining `living-far`, 13:00 manual, lights off, realistic/capable) because src/scene/CLAUDE.md records that a two-boot A/B of this app is not attributable. Arm B flips `weatherWetGlass` OFF under rain and arm C flips it back ON with nothing else changed -- one uniform, one boot. Arms D/D2 assert the DRY identity holds for every condition that is not rain; arm E samples the SAME scroll uniform twice 1.4 s apart with motion allowed and then with the in-app reduce-motion toggle on (frozen, and still WET); arm F drops to the phone tier and asserts no droplet map is bound there at all; arm G reads the PAINTED BACKDROP BYTES back off scene.background for all four conditions plus a flag-off control, because a screenshot cannot tell a re-bake that ran from one that was skipped; arm H is the deliberate rule-8 exception (rain wets glass at night, because wetness comes from precipitation and not from daylight); arm I re-runs the whole flag gate in Pro; arm J repeats at a true 390x844 phone viewport.

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setLightsMode?.('off'); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.setDeviceClass?.('capable'); s.setBackdrop?.('city'); s.setReduceMotion?.('off'); s.setWeather?.('clear'); s.hideLoading?.(); s.setFeatureFlag?.('interactiveDegrade', false) })()

steps.name: pin-device-class
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store; s.getState().setDeviceClass('capable'); s.setState({ setDeviceClass: () => {} }) })()

steps.name: install-probes
steps.eval: (() => { window.__wetProbe = (tag) => { const { scene } = window.__three; const panes = []; scene.traverse(o => { if (o.isMesh && o.userData && o.userData.glazing === true && o.material) panes.push(o) }); const m = panes.map(o => o.material); const s = window.__store.getState(); const row = { tag, weather: s.weather, tier: s.qualityTier, device: s.deviceClass, uiMode: s.uiMode, reduceMotion: s.reduceMotion, hour: s.manualHour, flagWet: s.featureFlags.weatherWetGlass, flagBackdrop: s.featureFlags.weatherBackdrop, panes: m.length, withNormalMap: m.filter(x => !!x.normalMap).length, withRoughnessMap: m.filter(x => !!x.roughnessMap).length, roughness: m.length ? Number((m.reduce((a,x) => a + x.roughness, 0) / m.length).toFixed(4)) : null, opacity: m.length ? Number((m.reduce((a,x) => a + x.opacity, 0) / m.length).toFixed(4)) : null, normalScale: m.length && m[0].normalScale ? Number(m[0].normalScale.x.toFixed(4)) : 0, trackOffsetY: m.length && m[0].roughnessMap ? Number(m[0].roughnessMap.offset.y.toFixed(5)) : null, repeat: m.length && m[0].roughnessMap ? [Number(m[0].roughnessMap.repeat.x.toFixed(2)), Number(m[0].roughnessMap.repeat.y.toFixed(2))] : null }; (window.__wetRows = window.__wetRows || []).push(row); console.log('[wetprobe] ' + JSON.stringify(row)); return row }; window.__bgProbe = (tag) => { const { scene } = window.__three; const img = scene.background && scene.background.image; const px = (u, v) => { if (!img || !img.width) return null; const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = img.width; c.height = img.height; const x = c.getContext('2d'); if (!x) return null; x.drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = x.getImageData(Math.round(u * (img.width - 1)), Math.round(v * (img.height - 1)), 1, 1).data; return [d[0], d[1], d[2]] }; const s = window.__store.getState(); const row = { tag, weather: s.weather, backdrop: s.backdrop, flagBackdrop: s.featureFlags.weatherBackdrop, size: img ? img.width + 'x' + img.height : null, zenith: px(0.5, 0.02), skyMid: px(0.5, 0.28), horizon: px(0.5, 0.47), ground: px(0.5, 0.75) }; (window.__bgRows = window.__bgRows || []).push(row); console.log('[bgprobe] ' + JSON.stringify(row)); return row }; window.__dumpRows = (tag) => { console.log('[wetdump:' + tag + '] ' + JSON.stringify({ wet: window.__wetRows || [], bg: window.__bgRows || [] })) } })()
